Name: Dino Form
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, eating a customizable food item (default [b]Purple Mushroom[/b]) transforms the player into a dinosaur for a set amount of time (default [b]sixty seconds[/b]).

Dinosaurs are big and will not fit through doors or some mine level entrances.

Dinosaurs have a -3 movement speed penalty and a +3 defense bonus.

Dinosaurs will trample any stones, weeds, or twigs they come into contact with (they will not trample crops, they are careful dinosaurs).

Dinosaurs can breathe fire by pressing a button (default [b]Mouse Left[/b]).

You can optionally set a transform key in the config to toggle dinosaur form at will.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746]Buff Framework[/url].


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.
